mapper.select: SELECT id, role, content, create_time AS createTime FROM agent_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY create_time ASC

SELECT id, conversation_id AS conversationId, role, content, prompt_tokens AS promptTokens, completion_tokens AS completionTokens, total_token_count AS totalTokenCount, model, finish_reason AS finishReason, create_time AS createTime FROM agent_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY create_time desc LIMIT #{limit}
